protocol.study_status: post-hoc descriptive extension after the original Bagging study
protocol.configuration_selection: new configurations fixed before these runs; no search on test scores
protocol.scope: configurations differ; this is not an isolated causal comparison of ensemble families
protocol.stacking_oof: 5-fold predictions within outer train; each scaler fits only its current fit fold
protocol.standardization: Only LR pipelines are scaled; trees and GaussianNB use original features
protocol.probabilities: Uncalibrated model probabilities; soft voting is not guaranteed to improve performance
protocol.interpretation: Mean +/- sample SD (ddof=1) across overlapping holdouts; not CI or significance test; not independent confirmation on new data

original_reference.depth: single-tree 5-fold train CV from {2,3,4,5,6}, shared per seed

Stacking.binary_meta_features: P(class=1) from each base; sklearn drops first column

configurations.reason_for_fixed_new_tree: Depth=3 is fixed for the new base trio; it is not selected using full outer-train labels before OOF prediction.
